summary: Enhance your skills with our Risk Based Internal Auditing Training Course. Learn to identify risks and improve audit effectiveness in your organization.
lede: Risk-based internal auditing is a methodology for directing audit work toward the risks most relevant to organizational objectives. It is designed for internal audit, risk and compliance professionals who need to structure audit coverage and allocate resources. Participants learn to map risks across an audit universe, build weighted risk-scoring models, and develop risk control matrices to guide targeted testing and reporting.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is structured for professionals responsible for designing, executing, and overseeing internal audit and risk management activities.
modules: Assessing the Audit Universe and Risk Landscape
prerequisites: Participants should possess a working knowledge of internal controls, basic audit procedures, and general enterprise risk concepts. While no advanced technical programming skills are required, familiarity with standard spreadsheet software is necessary for the risk modeling exercises. Reviewing your organization's current annual audit plan prior to attendance is highly recommended.
